sentence: Shows a fixed list of six sleeping spots at a cabin where each person in the chat can take one open spot or give theirs up, first claim wins.
use_when: A group is staying somewhere together and needs to sort out who sleeps where
Everyone should pick one bed or couch from a short fixed list
You want to see who still has no spot
dont_use_when: The options change or need to be added by people, like a custom list of rooms or items
People need to vote or rank choices rather than claim one first-come
You need to assign shifts, rides, or tasks instead of beds
